title: Generative AI
definition: A broad class of Artificial Intelligence systems that are capable of creating brand new, original content (text, images, audio, video) based on the patterns they learned from their training data.
simpleExplanation: Traditional AI analyzes things (e.g., 'Is this an image of a dog?'). Generative AI creates things (e.g., 'Draw me a brand new picture of a dog playing poker in space').
realWorldExample: ChatGPT generating an essay, Midjourney generating a digital painting, or Suno generating a pop song.

basic: Is a spam filter considered Generative AI?
intermediate: Why did Generative AI suddenly explode in popularity around 2022?

answers.question: Is spam filter GenAI?
answers.answer: No. A spam filter is an 'Analytical' or 'Discriminative' AI. It categorizes existing data. It does not create new data.

answers.question: Why 2022?
answers.answer: Breakthroughs in computing power and architecture (specifically Transformers and Diffusion models) finally allowed models to scale to a size where the generated content crossed the 'uncanny valley' and became virtually indistinguishable from human-created content.
